checks.detail: U = R23 U13(delta) R12 with NuFIT 6.0 NO (theta12 33.71 deg, theta13 8.56, theta23 43.28, delta 212): unitary to 1.1e-16; J = Im(U_e2 U_mu3 U*_e3 U*_mu2) = -0.01777 = c12 s12 c23 s23 c13^2 s13 sin(delta); J_max = 0.0335 (NuFIT: 0.0333 +- 0.0007)
checks.name: PMNS_unitary_and_Jarlskog

checks.detail: the roots of the exact 3 x 3 tip determinant det[diag(b_L) + kappa diag(b_R/a_R) kappa^dagger diag(a_L)] (mpmath, 50 digits) equal the one-generation roots with kappa_f = 1 to 3.0e-42 (relative) in all four sectors (neutrinos with kappa = U_PMNS, charged leptons, up quarks, down quarks with kappa = V_CKM), and the null vectors are the columns of the tip matrix to 1.1e-16: with a common doublet bulk mass the masses of um2_spectra.py are exact and the mixing matrices ARE the tip matrices
checks.name: three_generation_tip_condition_exact

checks.detail: for a random complex O(1) tip matrix (common c_L = 5.9529, c_R = -6, -9, -12) the exact roots agree with the singular values of zeta(c_L) kappa diag(zeta(-c_R)) to 3.5e-05, 2.8e-06, 2.0e-06 and the null vectors with its left singular vectors (overlaps 1.000000000, 1.000000000, 1.000000000): masses and left-handed mixing follow from the tip matrix and the wave functions at the tip
checks.name: general_tip_matrix

checks.detail: the coupling of the first even KK gauge mode to the zero modes, relative to the zero mode: left-handed leptons 0.14434 (universal: common c_L), left-handed quarks -0.30066; in the mass basis the largest off-diagonal element is 1.0e-17: no tree-level flavour-changing neutral current from the KK gauge bosons. With different doublet bulk masses (here |c_R| of e, mu, tau used as c_L) the PMNS rotation would create off-diagonal KK couplings up to 0.033
checks.name: no_tree_level_FCNC_from_KK

checks.detail: BR(mu -> e gamma) = (3 alpha/(32 pi)) |sum_i U*_mu i U_e i m_i^2/m_W^2|^2 = 2.8e-55 (Dirac neutrinos, GIM-suppressed): charged-lepton flavour violation is unobservable, as in the Standard Model with neutrino masses
checks.name: mu_to_e_gamma

checks.detail: every lepton doublet has c_L = 5.952883 and every quark doublet c_Q = 3.382304: the W and Z zero modes couple to all generations with the same strength (lepton universality; the CKM and PMNS matrices carry the whole flavour structure of the charged currents)
checks.name: lepton_universality

description: UM-2 flavour: three generations, the exact three-generation tip condition, PMNS and CKM from the tip matrices, no tree-level FCNC from the KK gauge bosons, mu -> e gamma, universality
